test: Windows job cancellation and timeout observe the compiler descendant exit before CLEAN cleanup
ownerBoundary: Existing platform test and implementation belong to the separate platform work; not edited by the Brain atlas audit.
observedFacts: First descendant heartbeat wait is bounded at 10 seconds and begins before worker source/toolchain preparation.
Worker timeout is 6 seconds from spawning PowerShell; it includes native helper compilation, job setup and Node startup.
The prior recorded failure occurred before cancellation was requested. Current run stack must be retained alongside this diagnosis.
Reviewer confirmed relevant live source matches the frozen candidate byte-for-byte.
hypothesis: Full-suite resource contention can exhaust one of the pre-heartbeat startup windows. This is plausible, not an established cause.
requiredInvariant: Observe a living descendant before cancellation. CLEAN requires nonce-bound empty-job proof, helper close, stopped descendant and then owned workspace removal. Uncertain termination remains UNKNOWN with quarantine.
interpretation: An isolated passing replay supports timing sensitivity but never erases the full-suite failure or proves its exact cause.
